All these applications were filed challenging the orders passed by the Adjudicating Officer and the Resident Additional Collector, at a point of time when the Tribunal was not set-up.

However, it is pointed out by the learned advocate that vide Government Notification dated 27th July, 2015, issued by the Deputy Secretary to the Government, Health and Family Welfare Department, Gandhinagar,
a Presiding Officer has been appointed for the purpose of appeals under Section 70 of the Act, and as per the proceedings mentioned under Rule 3.3 under Chapter III of Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011.

Sd/-
V.G. Vanzara Deputy Secretary to Government

All these applications are not pressed by the learned counsel appearing for the applicants, since the applicants intend to file statutory appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal.
Since the Tribunal has now started functioning, it will be open for the applicants to file appeals before the same.
The applicants shall file appeals within a period of six weeks from today.
All these applications are accordingly disposed of.
Interim relief to continue till 30.11.2015.
(J.B.PARDIWALA, J.)

opennyai_summary.facts: All these applications were filed challenging the orders passed by the Adjudicating Officer and the Resident Additional Collector, at a point of time when the Tribunal was not set-up.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 3 of section 70 (Chapter X on Adjudication and Food Safety Appellate Tribunal), of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (XXXIV of 2006) and rule 3.2 under Chapter III of Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011 thereunder and their application to the State of Gujarat, The Government of Gujarat hereby appoints Mr. R.N. Dave as Presiding Officer for the purpose of appeals under Section 70 of the Act, and as per the proceedings mentioned under Rule 3.3 under Chapter III of Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011.
His appointment would be for the period of five years or till he attains the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
By order and in the name of Governor of Gujarat.
Since the Tribunal has now started functioning, it will be open for the applicants to file appeals before the same.
The applicants shall file appeals within a period of six weeks from today.
All these applications are accordingly disposed of.
